definitions.explanation: Moving by walking, without a vehicle.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}から{徒歩|とほ}5{分|ふん}。
examples.english: 5 minutes on foot from the station.

notes:
{徒歩|とほ} means traveling on foot (without a vehicle).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {徒歩|とほ}で{行|い}く (go on foot)
- {徒歩|とほ}〜{分|ふん} (~ minutes on foot)
- {徒歩|とほ}{圏内|けんない} (within walking distance)
- {駅|えき}から{徒歩|とほ}5{分|ふん} (5-minute walk from station)

Real estate listings commonly use {徒歩|とほ}〜{分|ふん} to indicate distance from stations.

RELATED:
- {歩|ある}いて: on foot (casual)
- {歩行|ほこう}: walking (formal/technical)
